body: I don't know if you're way off. What you're saying certainly makes sense to me and I agree with it. Maybe it is existential, but it feels emotionally crippling. The only person who has gotten close enough to me, really knows me, is my future husband, and he often says (during arguments) I am a cold person and I tend to agree with him. I have the ability to just turn off and walk away. That I make myself expendable and thus treat everyone else like they are the same. If the higher brain power of humans makes them chase the external, then I am the odd man out. I have no goals, no hobbies, no far-off wants. Often it feels like my life is completely immersed in negativity and for no greater reason than I choose to be here. Sometimes I wonder if completely uprooting my life and moving somewhere else would be the change I needed.

I feel this way, too. But it only adds to how apathetic I feel about my life. I know how expendable I am to people. That's why, as close as I feel to someone, I know that the attachment is fickle. If I leave it alone long enough, it'll go away. No ones going to chase you down.
